purpose: Generate an independently judged GPT voter baseline through the owner's normal ChatGPT-managed Codex login, preserve E0 as a deterministic control, and add a separate auditable deliberation/counterfactual observatory.

baseline_roles.E0_DETERMINISTIC: retained immutable mechanics/control baseline; never relabeled as LLM output
baseline_roles.G0_CHATGPT_GPT56_SOL: candidate primary isolated GPT baseline generated through the owner's ChatGPT-managed Codex account
baseline_roles.R0_PUBLIC_BYO_LLM: independent reader-contributed replication cohort; not required to bootstrap G0

execution.resume_semantics: rerun command; validated work items are skipped; Codex threads are never resumed

D0_DECISION.role: freeze turnout and party probabilities before any narrative explanation

L0_OBSERVABLE_DELIBERATION.role: fresh-context structured explanation of immutable D0, tied to a closed evidence catalogue

CF_BEHAVIOURAL_ABLATIONS.role: fresh-context reruns of preregistered packet perturbations plus a non-political placebo

information_boundary.input: only the frozen prompt, row schema and one frozen work item

output_transport.scientific_row_schema: read verbatim from the frozen environment

promotion_gate: one frozen Sol model and reasoning effort for every D0 work item
ChatGPT-managed auth and no API key
all identities, row order, party keys, factor keys and simplexes valid
complete per-work-item output hashes and usage logs

frontend_policy.before_G0_promotion: continue labeling public numbers as E0 deterministic reference
frontend_policy.after_G0_promotion: G0 becomes the primary displayed simulation; E0 remains available as the deterministic control
frontend_policy.before_deliberation_promotion: show the observatory method without invented explanations
frontend_policy.after_deliberation_promotion: show structured explanations and separately labelled counterfactual diagnostics
frontend_policy.never_claim: that G0 or a fluent explanation is empirically true before blind historical scoring
frontend_policy.social_lambdas: remain illustrative until the separate 2016 calibration and 2021 holdout
